STEP 11. Check the harness wires between fog light relay 
connector A-06X and fog light connectors A-28 and A-31 
and combination meter connector C-43.
NOTE: After checking intermediate connectors C-06 and C-89, 
check the wires. If intermediate connectors C-06 and C-89 are 
damaged, repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between fog light relay connector 
A-06X and fog light connectors A-28 and A-31 and 
combination meter connector C-43 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 12.
NO : Repair them. The fog lights should illuminate 
normally.
